extensionName.description: Name of the extension, shown in the toolbar and the add-ons manager.

extensionDescription.message: Lists the video files and streams on the page you are looking at, ready to open or copy.
extensionDescription.description: Short description shown in the add-ons manager and on AMO.

searching.description: Shown while the page is being scanned.

foundCount.description: Header counter. Deliberately avoids plural forms, which the i18n API cannot express.

noVideos.description: Shown when the scan came back empty.

pageNotScannable.description: Shown for privileged pages that reject script injection, such as about: pages.

copyLink.description: Label of the button that copies the media URL.

copyCommand.description: Label of the button that copies a yt-dlp command for a stream.

copied.description: Button label right after a successful copy.

copyFailed.description: Button label when the clipboard rejected the write.

streamLabel.description: Marks a row as an adaptive manifest rather than a downloadable file.

streamTitleTooltip.message:
Adaptive stream. Copy the link and open it in VLC or mpv.
$url$

copyCommandTooltip.message:
Saves the video and audio tracks as one file:
$command$

streamHint.message: A stream is not a file. Paste the link into VLC or mpv to watch it now, or use the command to save it as one file.
streamHint.description: Footer note shown only when the results contain a manifest.

untitledVideo.description: Fallback title for a URL whose file name cannot be read.
